notes:
- White props fixed: the pews, benches, park benches, trash cans, hydrants, barrels, crates, cabinets
  and other realistic props that showed up plain white (on the Outskirts and elsewhere; the "tiny white
  chairs") have their textures back. The models had been imported before their textures were ready and
  kept blank materials; the build now re-imports them after the textures every time.
- Longshot reload: it now has a detachable box magazine that comes out and goes back in when you reload
  (the real model's magazine was part of the stock, so nothing moved).
- Grenades with a melee weapon out: holding G puts the melee weapon away for the throw, and it comes
  back out afterwards.
